Metadata.title: Taxful
Metadata.description: Your digital home for tax documents.

Home.title: Your invoices.
Home.description: Import documents, review the details and create validated e-invoices. From your accounting software to the finished file – all in one place.

flow.title: Your path to an e-invoice
flow.description: Documents from your accounting software are imported into Taxful as files, reviewed and approved. Validated XRechnung and ZUGFeRD files are prepared for your customers. Direct connections to the illustrated providers and submission to the tax office are not currently available.
flow.providerNote: Accounting software examples. File imports, without a direct integration.
